# Bizosto

> Bizosto is the Operating System for Service Businesses — a multi-tenant SaaS ERP for agencies, consultancies, and service firms with 10–200 employees. It unifies CRM, sales, project delivery, production, finance, HR, approvals, reports, and a branded client portal in one platform with 11 role-based dashboards.

Key facts:
- 14-day free trial. Card required at signup — you won't be charged until day 15. Cancel anytime before then and pay nothing.
- Pricing: Starter $79/mo ($790/yr) — 10 users, CRM + Sales + Projects, client portal, 20GB. Pro $149/mo ($1,490/yr) — 20 users, adds Finance, Production, AI Workforce, Website Embed, 75GB. Enterprise $299/mo ($2,990/yr) — unlimited users, adds HR, online client invoice payments via Stripe Connect, white-label, 250GB. Annual billing = 2 months free.
- Modules are assigned automatically by plan tier.
- AI Workforce (Pro and Enterprise): four AI agents — COO briefings, Finance monitoring, Sales pipeline analysis, and natural-language AI Reports. Bring-your-own API key; Bizosto never marks up AI usage.
- A 0.5% platform handling fee applies only to Enterprise client invoice payments processed via Stripe Connect — never to subscriptions.
- The client portal is Bizosto's primary differentiator: clients view project status, approve deliverables, upload files, and view invoices.
- App: https://app.bizosto.com — Signup: https://app.bizosto.com/signup
- Support: support@bizosto.com
